REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - APRIL 14, 2011 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.

4.

CONSENT CALENDAR

8.
Approval of Minutes
9.
Approval of Treasurer's Report
10.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
10A.
Request by Bank of America, N.A. for approval of a warehouse use at 16205 Distribution Way, Cerritos.
10B.
Proposal by Hassan & Sons to remodel the existing service station mechanic bay building located at 13356 South Street, Cerritos.
11.
PUBLIC WORKS ACTIVITIES
11A.
Consideration of contract award to relocate northerly boundary fence at Rosewood Park, 17715 Eric Avenue, Cerritos.
11B.
Consideration of approval of a General Services Agreement with Los Angeles County for various public works services.
11C.
Consideration of award for a revised contract for rehabilitation of water well C-1 at 12701 Artesia Boulevard, Cerritos.
11D.
Consideration of contract award for the installation of playground surgacing at Cerritos Park East, Cerritos.
12.
NEW AND OLD BUSINESS
12A.
Consideration of adoption of a Resolution of the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency authorizing expenditure of twenty percent housing set aside funds to reimburse the ABC Unified School District pursuant to the Affordable Housing, Financing, and Disposition and Development Agreement for the Cuesta Villas Project.
12B.
Consideration of a sub-recipient agreement between the City of Ceritos and the City of Los Angeles for the 2009 Recovery Act Justice Assistance Grant (JAG) Program award.
12C.
Consideration of appointments to vacancies on various commissions, boards, and committees.
12D.
Consideration of City Council Committee Assignments
13.

14.
